payload.hypothesis: Between 2000 BCE and 1100 BCE the highest growth phase is 1500-1200 BCE, peaking in the century 1400-1301 BCE (openness growth concentrated in 1400-1200 BCE). Primary metric (100-year percentage/absolute change of the 100-year smoothed landscape-openness pollen PC1 score) gives 1400-1301 BCE +1.128 score units per century (+317.9% at bin level), rank 1 under all six openness series variants, followed by 1300-1201 BCE (+0.556, +37.5%) and 1800-1701 BCE (+0.510). Secondary metric (g_all_mean, mean of all-capital KDE growth rates) peaks one century earlier at 1500-1401 BCE (+0.00283/yr) and is second highest in 1400-1301 BCE (+0.00145/yr), where kde_all_mean also reaches its maximum level (4.14e-4) and kde_all_detrend is still rising. 1400-1301 BCE is the only century in the top two under both mainlines, hence the single best-supported highest-growth century.
payload.workflow: 1) Input verification: time_series_data.csv annual (CE -4100..-500, step 1, 3601 rows), capital.csv 100-yr grid (BCE 4300..500, 39 rows), pollen file annual (CE -4785..-702); calBP=1950-CE verified; capital Z columns equal ts columns exactly under CE=-BCE (max|diff|=0, n=37). 2) Window CE -2000..-1100 (901 annual rows) split into 9 century bins (endpoint -1100 folded into the 1300-1201 BCE bin) plus a capital 100-yr grid anchored sensitivity. 3) Metric A (primary, landscape openness): 100-year change of the 100-year smoothed openness computed three ways - A1 literal pointwise percentage change (reported, but artefact-prone because the PC1 score crosses zero), A2 bin-level percentage change with mean|previous values| denominator, A3 absolute change in score units - on 7 series variants (Belau smoothed/annual, SMOOTH_MEAN_50/100/150y, Belau+Woserin MEAN, Woserin only). 4) Metric B: century means of g_all_mean and g_all_std. 5) Metric C: per-century delta-Z of the *_inter capital series aggregated into the four approved classes (symbolic/social/cultural/economic) with a flat-series detector flagging bins where delta-Z=0 means no observations. 6) Cross-validation: kde_all_mean level and per-century slope, kde_all_detrend slope, as-shipped pollen_grate_100 century means, smoothing-window and site sensitivity, grid re-anchoring. No formal significance tests (agreed). Output: work/final_report.md.
answer_centuries: 1400-1301 BCE (rank 1 openness growth, rank 2 capital growth)
1500-1401 BCE (rank 1 capital growth and steepest KDE rise; openness still declining)
payload.primary_metric: 100-year percentage change (and absolute change) of the 100-year smoothed landscape-openness pollen PC1 score (Belau)
payload.secondary_metric: g_all_mean (mean of all-capital KDE growth rates), cross-checked with kde_all_mean level/slope, kde_all_detrend slope and per-class delta-Z
payload.reported_disagreement: Openness-growth peak (1400-1301 BCE) vs capital-growth peak (1500-1401 BCE) differ by one century; shipped pollen_grate_100 column not reproducible (clipped at +/-1%, century r=0.347, whole-file |r|<=0.18) and used only as contrast; pointwise percentage change explodes where openness crosses zero (min|denominator| = 0.008 in 1400-1301 BCE).
